name: TaoTronics TT-DL13 Eye-Caring LED Desk Lamp with USB Charging Port
description: Upgrade your study or work setup with this highly popular TaoTronics TT-DL13 LED Desk Lamp! Engineered with premium anodized aluminum alloy, it features 5 customizable color temperatures (2700K–6000K) and 7 unique brightness levels controlled via a sleek touch-sensitive base track. The flicker-free, eye-caring diffusion panel makes it perfect for long hours of reading or coding without eye fatigue. It also includes an integrated, stable iSmart USB charging port on the side to conveniently power your smartphone or tablet. The lamp's highly adjustable design allows you to tilt the head up 135°, swivel 90°, and pivot the base up to 150° for custom lighting angles. Coming from a pet-friendly student home with a cat, the lamp and original power adapter have been thoroughly sanitized with isopropyl alcohol wipes and blast-cleaned with compressed air before listing. Fully tested and in pristine working order.
contact_note: Fully pre-assembled and includes its original power supply brick. Ready to plug in and use immediately. Packaged back safely in its original retail box shell shown in the image. Completely cat-friendly disclosure: while thoroughly sanitized with alcohol, it comes from a home with a cat.
meta_description: Shop the TaoTronics TT-DL13 eye-caring LED desk lamp. Features 5 color modes, 7 brightness levels, built-in USB charging port, and adjustable aluminum arm.
name_zh: TaoTronics TT-DL13 智能触控LED护眼台灯 (带USB充电口)
description_zh: 自用极新 TaoTronics 经典爆款 TT-DL13 智能 LED 护眼台灯，带原装原厂电源适配器与完整原装彩盒。采用高质感阳极氧化铝合金支架，底座触控条支持 5 种色温调节（2700K–6000K 暖白到冷白）以及 7 档亮度无级微调。光线柔和无频闪、无重影，非常适合留学生或极客熬夜写代码、看书、高效办公，最大程度缓解眼部疲劳。灯身侧面自带一个 iSmart USB 充电输出口，可以随时给手机、平板或耳机充电。灯头支持 135° 俯仰和 90° 旋转，底座支持 150° 前后调节。因家里养猫，出海鲜市场前已用医用酒精对台灯和线材进行了深度擦拭和清灰。功能全完好，插电即用，自提的小伙伴请直接带走原装盒子包装。
